notes: שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים is fused under rule 30's one-English-word condition; the alternative, marking עִזִּים unrepresented, is recorded in the unit's note.
אָשָׁם and חַטָּאת both head on the lexeme-bearing word (*trespass*, *sin*) rather than on the supplied generic *offering*, following rule 31's treatment of עֹלָה → *burnt offerings*.
